Why this campaign? 🎯Today's students don't live one lifestyle

Their needs change from studying and gaming to travelling, entertainment and everyday life. Yet most plans still expect students to fit their needs into a fixed package.

We wanted to change that.

We created this campaign to introduce a more flexible and rewarding stc youth experience — one that gives students more control, more value and more reasons to stay engaged.

SAVE.Save the value of what you don't use.

Recycle. Reward. Give Back. ♻️The CSR arm of the campaign

The concept

Customers donate their old phones at any stc branch. In return, they receive Youth Rewards points.

stc collects the donated phones and works with a trusted partner to recycle or refurbish them. The refurbished devices are then donated to students and people in need — helping them access education and stay connected.

“Your old phone can build someone else's future.”
How it works
1Donate your old phone at any stc branch
2Receive Youth Rewards points
3stc refurbishes or responsibly recycles the device
4Refurbished phones go to students and people in need
